provider_source.source_of_truth_boundary: AOF export summarizes local runtime evidence, not raw provider transcript truth.

event_summaries.summary: AOF selected v9.9 as the next bounded release after v9.7.
AOF framed v9.9 as a production readiness review, not live provider execution.
AOF runtime recorded TASK-119 as the v9.9 release work item.
AOF created release definition, checklist, and release notes for the readiness review.
AOF updated README, Quickstart, capability matrix, active release manifest, and operating goals to v9.9.
AOF runtime verified organization, archmap impact, release-state, tests, and smoke before release.
Live provider execution safety, provider credentials, market truth, and external operator acceptance remain not proven.
Release must stop if it presents v9.9 as production execution rather than a readiness review.

risk_candidates: Readiness review could be confused with production authorization.
Internal self-hosting readiness is not third-party acceptance.

redaction_boundary: The export excludes raw provider transcript and secrets; it records bounded local AOF artifact refs and summaries.
release_ready_boundary: Release-ready means readiness review evidence is complete and auditable; it does not mean production execution is approved.
not_proven: Session export does not prove raw transcript completeness, live provider execution, production safety, or external operator acceptance.
